A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''bully''' used a rock to smash a toy [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] belonging to the [[Human/Legends|Human]] child [[Harsh]]. Harsh, despite being smaller than the bully, took the rock from the other child and smashed the bully's face with it.<ref name="SWG6" />

==Behind the scenes==
The bully was mentioned in ''[[Unusual Suspects]]'', an article written by [[Andrew Hind]] and published in [[Wizards of the Coast]]s' [[Star Wars Gamer 6|''Star Wars Gamer'' 6]] in [[July]] of [[2001]].<ref name="SWG6" />
